thesis: The hosts discuss the Enron scandal as a parallel to the recent FTX collapse, framing it as a story of a public company that used self-dealing and leverage to hide problems while executives profited at the expense of shareholders. They contextualize Enron's rise within the economic turmoil of the 1970s and 1980s, specifically noting how oil crises and high interest rates under Paul Volcker ended the post-WWII economic growth miracle.
